tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background behind every panel. Warm paper-white in light, near-black in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables, the activity feed and the checkout bar.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, table headers, row hover, search fields and wells inside a card.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card borders, dividers, table row rules. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and secondary buttons (3:1 on surface and paper in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on paper, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (authors, timestamps, meta) on paper, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Deep crimson. Primary buttons, the Lend/Return button, active tab underline, stat numerals' accent. Never used to mean an error.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and brand-hover fills.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Crimson text: links, 'See all', selected tab labels, on paper and surface.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill for a selected row, an active filter chip, the library avatar ring ground. Text on it is ink or brand-text.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar background: a deep oxblood binding in light, near-black in dark.

tokens.name: sidebar-ink
tokens.usage: Nav labels and icons on sidebar and sidebar-active.

tokens.name: sidebar-muted
tokens.usage: Section labels and category counts on sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-active
tokens.usage: Background of the selected nav item.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Foil accent: the active-nav marker, rank numbers' underline, cover bands. A mark colour, not a text colour on paper.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Overdue and destructive states: text and icons on surface, paper and danger-soft. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Overdue badge and overdue alert rows.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid danger fill (5.7:1 in light, 6.8:1 in dark).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Due soon: text and icons on surface, paper and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Due soon badge.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Available, returned, active member: text and icons on surface, paper and success-soft. Teal, so it never relies on red-green alone.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Available and Returned badges.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of Lost, Damaged and Withdrawn badges (text: ink-muted).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Meets 3:1 on paper and surface in both themes; inside the light sidebar the ring is sidebar-ink instead.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The library name in the dashboard header. Once per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Book titles, member names, card titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Returned 2 days late by Ana Popescu.
styles.usage: Default UI text, table cells, form values.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Authors, book numbers, timestamps; colour ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: section eyebrows, 'See all', table headers, badge text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside rows and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in lists and tables.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between dashboard sections; page gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Header padding; space above a section title.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large page breaks only.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, book cover thumbnails, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows on hover, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels: the activity feed, the checkout bar, report cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill buttons, search fields, avatars and the round Lend/Return button.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and panels resting on paper.

tokens.name: shadow-bar
tokens.usage: The sticky checkout bar along the bottom.
